name: Phonon 31M (on-device English TTS model)
summary: Small text-to-speech model from Gradium, built on Kyutai's Pocket TTS and Mimi codec: 31M parameters, 24 kHz English speech, streams audio while generating, 64.5 MB q8 GGUF. Runs on a laptop CPU, phone, Raspberry Pi or in a browser tab (WebGPU), via Python (ptts), a CLI binary or npm (phonon-tts). Useful for offline narration and voice in apps.

access.notes: Only the 31M English model is Apache-2.0. The 40M models (en, fr, de, es, pt, multilingual) are CC BY-NC 4.0, so no commercial use. Runtime xn-ptts is Apache-2.0.

procedure: CLI: uvx ptts --lang en --quant q8 --voice Easton "Hello from Phonon." -o speech.wav (or brew install gradium-ai/tap/ptts)
Python: pip install ptts, then ptts.TTS("hf://gradium/phonon-31m-en", lang="en", quant="q8")
Weights download automatically from Hugging Face, no account or gating

verdict.why: Tiny, genuinely on-device TTS with a permissive license on the English 31M model (Apache-2.0 per model card), ~139k downloads, runtime repo 438 stars. Released Oct 19 but resurfaced today; watch the NC license on the 40M siblings.
